newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASIA PRODUCT SWAPS - Jet down on low Taiwan award.
newsitem.headline: ASIA PRODUCT SWAPS - Jet down on low Taiwan award.

text.p: Singapore jet fuel swaps came under selling pressure late afternoon on Thursday following the purchase of two jet fuel December cargoes by Taiwan at relatively low prices and increased supplies, traders said.
Taiwan bought two 32,000-tonne cargoes at $241-$242 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis, about $3 below market expectations, they said.

Prices were also hit by the shipment of arbitrage cargoes from the U.S. West Coast and Venezuela to cover Japanese winter requirement despite the ready availability of stocks in Guam and China, traders said.

The Singapore November jet fuel/gas oil spread (regrade) was offered down to a low of 10 cents with no firm bids seen against against it, brokers said. November regrade was quoted earlier in the day at 10/30 cents.
December regrade also fell to trade at 50 cents and offered again at this level against earlier quotes at 50/70, brokers said. The Q1 regrade was offered at $1.00.

November gas oil swaps was largely unchanged from earlier and was last quoted at $30.15/$30.25. It traded earlier in the day at $30.35, up sharply from Wednesday's late market of $29.70/$29.80, brokers said.
December gas oil swaps were quoted at $29.55/$29.70, up from Wednesday's $29.05/29.15. December traded in the morning at $29.70 and $29.75.
The November/December spread was quoted at 60/70 cents with the December/January called at 55/70, steady on the day earlier.
Fuel oil swaps also picked up as a result of Wednesday's physical purchases by a local trader for two 20,000-tonne lots at $117.00 and $117.50 per tonne, free on board Singapore.
November swaps were quoted at $117.00/$118.00 per tonne and December swaps were at $116.00/$117.25, about $1.50 more than Wednesday's close, brokers said.
The November/December spread widened from around flat on Wednesday to about $1.00 due to the strong prompt buying interest with players uncertain over December.
November naphtha was notionally quoted at $21.75/$21.90, up slightly from Wednesday's close of $21.65/$21.85.
